profile.headline: Senior React | JavaScript | TypeScript Developer
profile.summary: I have 8+ years of experience developing solutions for clients in a broad range of industries. As a member of the development teams that have implemented and supported enterprise software, I am always looking to learn more about new technologies and methods as the industry changes. The goal is always to be at the forefront of application development with a focus on building solid and scalable systems to meet my client's needs. Currently, I support Lockheed Martin in Houston, TX working primarily with Microsoft technologies in an Enterprise Application Development capacity. Primary skills in SQL Server management (back end)
